description: This file defines a function 'tasteOfYum' that scrapes recipe data from 'pinchofyum.com' web pages, extracting metadata, ingredients, instructions, tags, and timing information, and returns a structured Recipe object.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe data, including image, name, ingredients, instructions, tags, time, and servings.

methods.name: tasteOfYum
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and parses a recipe page from 'pinchofyum.com', returning a structured Recipe object with extracted data.
